questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: If y = 3x² + 2x, what is dy/dx at x = 2?
questions.explanation: dy/dx = 6x + 2; at x = 2 this is 14.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: Evaluate the definite integral of 2x from x = 0 to x = 3.
questions.explanation: An antiderivative is x². Subtracting the endpoint values gives 9 − 0.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: A right triangle has opposite side 3 m and hypotenuse 5 m. What is sin θ?
questions.explanation: Sine is opposite divided by hypotenuse: 3/5 = 0.6.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: Solve 2x + 7 = 19.
questions.explanation: Subtract 7 to obtain 2x = 12, then divide by 2.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: What is the slope of the line through (1, 2) and (4, 8)?
questions.explanation: Slope is change in y divided by change in x: (8−2)/(4−1) = 2.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: Convert 180 degrees to radians.
questions.explanation: A full turn is 360° = 2π radians; a half-turn is π radians.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: For y = e^(2x), which derivative is correct?
questions.explanation: The chain rule multiplies the exponential by the derivative of 2x, which is 2.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: Solve dy/dx = 4 with initial condition y(0) = 3.
questions.explanation: Integrating a constant slope gives y = 4x + C. The initial condition makes C = 3.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: A velocity is v(t) = 3t² m/s. What is acceleration at t = 2 s?
questions.explanation: Acceleration is dv/dt = 6t, giving 12 m/s².
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: What is the distance between (0, 0) and (3, 4)?
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: Find the determinant of the matrix with rows (2, 1) and (3, 4).
questions.explanation: For a 2 × 2 matrix the determinant is ad − bc: 2×4 − 1×3 = 5.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: For x ≠ 1, simplify (x² − 1)/(x − 1).
questions.explanation: Factor the numerator into (x−1)(x+1), then cancel x−1. The restriction x ≠ 1 remains.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: For ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and V = 50 m/s, what is dynamic pressure?
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: For q = 500 Pa, wing area 10 m² and CL = 0.8, what is lift?
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: At fixed density, area and lift coefficient, doubling airspeed changes lift by what factor?
questions.explanation: Lift varies with V² under these fixed conditions, so (2V)²/V² = 4.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: At q = 600 Pa, S = 20 m² and CD = 0.03, what is drag?
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: What most directly causes an aerodynamic stall on a conventional wing?
choices: Exceeding the critical angle of attack
Flying below one universal ground speed
questions.explanation: A stall results when angle of attack exceeds the critical value and flow separation substantially reduces lift.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: What is Mach number?
choices: True airspeed divided by local speed of sound
questions.explanation: Mach number compares flow speed with the speed of sound at the local conditions.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: In steady, unaccelerated, level flight, lift is approximately equal to which force?
questions.explanation: With no vertical acceleration and the usual near-horizontal thrust assumption, vertical forces balance: lift equals weight.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: For a coordinated level turn at 60° bank, what is the load factor?
questions.explanation: n = 1/cos φ. With cos 60° = 0.5, the load factor is 2.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: If load factor rises from 1 to 4 at unchanged configuration and weight, stall speed changes by what factor?
questions.explanation: Stall speed varies with √n, so √4 = 2.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: For an incompressible steady flow, if streamtube area halves, what happens to mean speed?
questions.explanation: Continuity gives AV = constant when density is constant, so halving A doubles V.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: Which response defines positive static longitudinal stability after a small pitch disturbance?
choices: An initial pitching tendency toward the original equilibrium
questions.explanation: Static stability concerns the initial restoring tendency. Damping and later oscillations concern dynamic stability.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: aero
questions.prompt: With other factors fixed, increasing aspect ratio generally does what to induced drag coefficient?
questions.explanation: CDi = CL²/(π e AR). A higher AR lowers induced drag coefficient when CL and e are fixed.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: A 10,000 N axial tensile load acts on 100 mm². What is average normal stress?
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: A 2 m bar elongates by 1 mm. What is engineering strain?
questions.explanation: Strain = ΔL/L = 0.001/2 = 0.0005, dimensionless.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: With E = 70 GPa and elastic strain 0.001, what is uniaxial stress?
questions.explanation: Within the linear elastic range, σ = Eε = 70×10⁹×0.001 = 70×10⁶ Pa.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: A simply supported 4 m beam has a 1,000 N point load at midspan. What is each vertical reaction?
questions.explanation: Symmetry gives equal reactions; their sum must balance the 1000 N downward load.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: For that 4 m simply supported beam and 1,000 N midspan load, what is maximum bending moment?
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: Using σ = My/I, where is bending normal stress zero in a homogeneous beam under pure bending?
questions.explanation: Distance y from the neutral axis is zero there, making bending normal stress zero.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: A 20 N force acts perpendicular to a lever 0.5 m from a pivot. What torque results?
questions.explanation: Torque magnitude is force times perpendicular lever arm: 20×0.5 = 10 N·m.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: Which structural member primarily carries axial compressive load?
questions.explanation: A strut is designed to resist compression; instability by buckling must be considered.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: In Euler buckling with fixed E, I and end conditions, doubling column length changes critical load by what factor?
questions.explanation: Pcr = π²EI/(KL)². Doubling L increases the denominator fourfold.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: A 100 kg mass is at x = 1 m and a 300 kg mass is at x = 3 m. Where is their combined CG?
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: Allowable stress is 150 MPa and applied stress is 100 MPa. Using MS = allowable/applied − 1, what is margin of safety?
questions.explanation: MS = 150/100 − 1 = 0.5; it is dimensionless.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: structures
questions.prompt: Which describes fatigue failure?
choices: Crack initiation and growth under repeated loading
A guaranteed increase in strength with cycles
questions.explanation: Repeated stress cycles can grow cracks even when nominal stress is below static ultimate strength.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: Which process uses penetrant and developer to reveal surface-breaking discontinuities in a clean nonporous part?
questions.explanation: Liquid penetrant enters open surface flaws; developer helps draw it out to make indications visible.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: Magnetic particle inspection is suitable primarily for which material class?
questions.explanation: The method relies on a magnetic field and leakage at discontinuities in ferromagnetic material.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: What combination promotes galvanic corrosion?
choices: Dissimilar metals in electrical contact with an electrolyte
questions.explanation: An electrically connected dissimilar-metal pair and electrolyte can form a galvanic cell.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: Before drilling or cutting a structural repair, what should determine allowable limits and repair details?
choices: Applicable approved maintenance or repair data
A guess based only on sheet color
questions.explanation: Use applicable approved data such as the aircraft structural repair manual; generic guidance does not override aircraft-specific requirements.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: What is the principal reinforcing role of fibers in a fiber-reinforced polymer laminate?
choices: Carry much of the load along their direction
questions.explanation: Fibers provide high directional stiffness and strength; the matrix transfers load and protects the fibers.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: What is delamination in a composite laminate?
questions.explanation: Delamination is separation between plies and may reduce structural capacity without obvious surface damage.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: Why is a torque wrench used when a specified fastener torque is required?
choices: To apply a controlled tightening torque
To prove all cracks are absent
questions.explanation: A calibrated torque wrench controls the applied torque; specified lubrication and procedure affect the resulting preload.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: What is the main function of safety wire installed correctly on a suitable fastener?
questions.explanation: Safety wire is a locking device arranged to oppose loosening. It does not replace proper tightening or repair damaged threads.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: Why are cracks generally unacceptable stress raisers in a loaded aircraft structure?
choices: They always reduce local stress to zero
questions.explanation: A crack tip causes a local stress concentration; crack growth must be evaluated with applicable limits and approved repair data.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: For a flush-riveted thin skin, countersinking versus dimpling should be chosen using what?
choices: Applicable repair data and material/thickness limits
questions.explanation: Excessive countersinking can remove too much material. The repair data specify an appropriate method for the skin and fastener.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: What is traceability in aircraft material control?
choices: Linking a part or material to its identity and required records
questions.explanation: Traceability connects identity, source and required acceptance documentation; appearance alone cannot establish airworthiness.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: construction
questions.prompt: What must happen after a repair before return to service?
choices: Required inspection and authorized documentation per applicable rules
Only verbal approval by a passenger
questions.explanation: A completed physical repair still needs the prescribed inspections and authorized records. Applicable Philippine requirements govern local practice.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: What is the ideal four-stroke spark-ignition engine sequence?
questions.explanation: Each operating cycle contains these four piston strokes, normally across two crankshaft revolutions.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: A four-stroke single cylinder completes one power stroke in how many crankshaft revolutions?
questions.explanation: Four strokes require 720° of crank rotation, equal to two complete revolutions.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: For compression ratio (Vs + Vc)/Vc, with swept volume 450 cm³ and clearance volume 50 cm³, what is the ratio?
questions.explanation: (450+50)/50 = 10. Include clearance volume in the total volume at bottom dead center.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: What supplies most of the shaft work needed by a simple turbojet compressor?
questions.explanation: The turbine extracts energy from the hot gas stream and transmits shaft work to the compressor.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of a compressor in a gas turbine engine?
choices: Convert exhaust thrust directly into lift
Eliminate the need for a turbine
questions.explanation: The compressor raises pressure before heat addition in the combustor.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: Which ideal thermodynamic cycle models the basic constant-pressure gas turbine?
questions.explanation: The ideal Brayton cycle uses isentropic compression/expansion and constant-pressure heat addition/rejection.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: For a heat engine receiving 1,000 J and delivering 300 J net work, what is thermal efficiency?
questions.explanation: Thermal efficiency is Wnet/Qin = 300/1000 = 0.30.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: A shaft delivers 100 N·m at 100 rad/s. What is shaft power?
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: What is the principal function of a propeller?
choices: Convert shaft power into propulsive thrust
questions.explanation: A rotating propeller accelerates air and converts engine shaft power into thrust, with aerodynamic losses.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: Why is engine lubrication necessary?
choices: Reduce friction and help remove heat between moving surfaces
questions.explanation: An oil film reduces friction and wear. Oil also transports heat and contaminants; it does not eliminate every failure mode.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: Ignoring fuel mass and pressure thrust, mass flow 20 kg/s accelerated from 100 to 300 m/s produces what thrust?
questions.explanation: F = ṁ(Ve−V0) = 20×(300−100) = 4000 N under the stated assumptions.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: powerplant
questions.prompt: A detonation event in a spark-ignition engine is best described as what?
choices: Abnormal rapid combustion of the end gas
Normal spark timing in every cycle
questions.explanation: Detonation involves abnormal end-gas autoignition and pressure waves. It differs from preignition, which begins before the scheduled spark.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: Which Philippine decree specifically regulates aeronautical engineering practice?
questions.explanation: PD 1570 is the Philippine Aeronautical Engineering Decree. Other laws may apply to particular activities but do not replace this professional law.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: Under PD 1570 Section 17, what general weighted average is required, with no subject below 50%?
questions.explanation: Section 17 states a general weighted average of 75% with no rating below 50% in any subject. Check current PRC issuances for examination updates.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: Under PD 1570 Section 3, the Board of Aeronautical Engineering is created under which body?
choices: Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines
questions.explanation: The decree creates the Board under the PRC. Professional registration and aircraft operating regulation have different institutional roles.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: What is the title given to PD 1570 in Section 1?
questions.explanation: Section 1 supplies the short title Philippine Aeronautical Engineering Decree.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: At 10% simple interest per year, what interest accrues on ₱10,000 over 2 years?
questions.explanation: Simple interest I = Prt = 10000×0.10×2 = ₱2000. This excludes repayment of principal.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: What is the future value of ₱10,000 after 2 years at 10% interest compounded annually?
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: What is the present value of ₱11,000 due in one year at a 10% annual discount rate?
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: An asset costs ₱100,000, has ₱20,000 salvage value and a 4-year life. What is annual straight-line depreciation?
questions.explanation: Annual depreciation = (cost−salvage)/life = (100000−20000)/4 = ₱20000.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: A project costs ₱1,000 now and returns ₱1,210 in 2 years. At 10% annually, what is NPV?
questions.explanation: NPV = −1000 + 1210/(1.1²) = 0. A zero NPV earns exactly the assumed discount rate.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: Fixed cost is ₱10,000 and contribution margin is ₱100 per unit. What is the break-even quantity?
questions.explanation: Break-even quantity = fixed cost / (unit price−unit variable cost) = 10000/100 = 100 units.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: Under PD 1570 Section 7, which is a power of the Board, subject to Commission review?
choices: Issue, suspend or revoke registration certificates for justifiable cause
questions.explanation: Section 7 includes professional registration powers, exercisable within the decree and Commission oversight.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending

questions.subject: ethics
questions.prompt: Under PD 1570 Section 19, who may take the professional oath for a registrant besides a Board member?
choices: A person authorized to administer oaths
questions.explanation: Section 19 permits the oath before a Board member or another person authorized to administer oaths.
questions.reviewer: AE Prepware initial author self-review; faculty review pending
